prompts.prompt: Wide interior of a compact geothermal bakehouse built from dark fitted stone: six glowing arched ovens and copper heat pipes on the north wall, a cold stone washing trough at northwest, a long flour-dusted scoring table across the center, reed bread trays and hostel door on the west wall, a burial-meal shelf and descending south stair, and a slatted ironwood east door opening to a steep furnace-court stair. Ves, a sturdy medium-brown adult with short black curls under a cream headcloth and a flour-gray apron, scores flat ration loaves while three varied bakers work with long wooden peels.

Medium-wide view along a bakehouse scoring table toward a slatted court door and upper stair landing. Ves works with clay tally ties; Enka, an older broad dark-skinned store steward in a red apron, stacks bread with three iron keys visible; Salen, a lean carrier in a patched gray cloak, holds a lidded burial basket by the south stair; Taru, a thick-set man with a scarred right hand and charcoal wrap, warms his hands at an oven; Melka, a tall dark-skinned mortuary witness in a pale sash, waits beyond the slats with a rigid palewood case.

Overhead close view of a flour-dusted dark wood worktable under oven light. Three records remain visibly separate on cloth squares: thin answer-roll leaves tied with scored clay seals and small gesture drawings, a withdrawal tally with hostel and shrine marks beside cold copper tokens, and a bread tray list aligned with flat loaves, lamp-oil cups, and household markers. Ves's floury hands hold a blunt bone scorer; Enka's three keys rest beside the tray list; Taru's scarred hand touches only the recognizer copy.

High corner view of one compact geothermal bakehouse as a practical conspiracy map. Sturdy brown-skinned Ves in a cream headcloth and flour-gray apron can divide copy leaves among clay ties at the central table; older broad dark-skinned Enka in a red apron with three iron keys can fill publicly marked bread and lamp-oil trays on the west wall; thick-set Taru in a charcoal wrap, his right hand scarred, can raise household marks with two bakers; lean Salen in a patched gray carrier cloak can carry a lidded burial basket toward the south stair. Six hot ovens line the north wall, a cold trough sits northwest, a hostel door opens west, and a slatted court door rises east toward an upper landing.

Wide view of ordinary bread work continuing inside a compact geothermal bakehouse after a covert preparation. Flat loaves move from six north-wall ovens to a long central scoring table and then into reed trays on the west wall. Sturdy brown-skinned Ves in a cream headcloth and flour-gray apron keeps the household tally; older broad dark-skinned Enka in a red apron with three iron keys works the trays; thick-set Taru in a charcoal wrap waits near the slatted east court door; two varied bakers maintain the line. A bronze horn mouth high beyond the door catches light; cold trough, burial shelf, south stair, and upper landing preserve the room's routes.

Low-angle pivotal frame inside a soot-dark high-fantasy bakehouse looking toward a slatted east court door. A bronze horn mouth above the upper landing vibrates; loose flour lifts from a central scoring table; six oven flames lean under changing furnace draft; copper pipes and court-weight chains catch ember light. Sturdy brown-skinned Ves in a cream headcloth and flour-gray apron, older broad dark-skinned Enka in a red apron with three iron keys, and thick-set Taru in a charcoal wrap with a scarred right hand turn toward the door while scored clay seals and bread trays remain in their working places.

Medium confrontation across a flour-dusted bakehouse table. Compact ochre-brown Nema, black hair in a severe knot above a soot-black wrap edged with oxidized copper, descends through the east court door carrying a rigid bronze case and places a torn clay-tied route strip on the table. Sturdy brown-skinned Ves in a cream headcloth and flour-gray apron faces her with scorer and day tally; older broad dark-skinned Enka in a red apron covers three store keys with a floury hand; thick-set Taru in a charcoal wrap looks toward the upper stair. Hot ovens glow behind them and cold shaft light frames the registrar.

Table-side political choice in a geothermal bakehouse. Compact ochre-brown registrar Nema in a copper-edged black wrap stands behind a torn route strip and open bronze case on the east side of a flour-dusted table. Sturdy brown-skinned Ves in a cream headcloth and flour-gray apron stands opposite with four visible tools: a lawful four-name office list, an open household bread tally, a scored copy leaf beside a lidded burial basket, and a blunt bone scorer above the next loaf. Older broad dark-skinned Enka in a red apron guards marked relief trays on the west side; thick-set Taru in a charcoal wrap waits by the slatted court door.

Close overhead view of a fired-clay passage token beside a torn route strip and an open bronze registrar's case on a flour-dusted scoring table. Separate cloth squares hold a tally keeper's office list, bread tally, and remaining scored copy leaves. Thick-set Taru's scarred right hand waits near the token; compact registrar Nema's ink-dark fingertips hold the strip; sturdy Ves's floury hand points a bone scorer between them. Through the slatted door at the top of frame, tall very dark-skinned Melka in a long linen coat and pale sash waits on a stone landing with a rigid palewood mortuary case.

Low-angle threshold decision at a slatted ironwood bakehouse door. One fired-clay passage token rests on a stone ledge. Sturdy brown-skinned Ves in a cream headcloth and flour-gray apron stands below it; thick-set Taru in a charcoal wrap waits with a household copy and scarred right hand visible; a young brown-skinned porter in rolled work wraps holds a lidded burial basket; older broad dark-skinned Enka in a red apron steadies the first relief tray; compact ochre-brown Nema in a copper-edged black wrap guards the rising court stair with a bronze case; tall very dark-skinned Melka in a linen coat and pale sash waits higher with an empty palewood case. Ember oven light meets pale stair light across clearly separated people, records, food, and routes.

High corner view of the complete Ninth Furnace bakehouse pressure map before a second horn: six hot north-wall ovens and copper pipes, cold northwest trough, central table with separate copy leaves, household tally, torn route strip, and bronze case, west relief trays beside a hostel door, south burial shelf and descending stair, east slatted court door and rising landing. Sturdy brown-skinned Ves in a cream headcloth and flour-gray apron stands at the table; older broad dark-skinned Enka in a red apron stands at the trays; thick-set Taru in a charcoal wrap waits near the court door; compact ochre-brown Nema in a copper-edged black wrap guards the threshold; varied household witnesses line the west wall as flour trembles under tested weights.

Long sightline from a bakehouse scoring table through a slatted court door to an upper landing. Sturdy brown-skinned Ves in a cream headcloth and flour-gray apron reads a withdrawal tally from below; thick-set Taru in a charcoal wrap stands below the threshold with a recognizer copy and scarred right hand visible; tall very dark-skinned Melka in a long linen coat and pale sash holds a closed palewood mortuary case higher on the stair; compact ochre-brown Nema in a copper-edged black wrap writes beside an open bronze branch case. Each occupies a distinct level and holds a distinct record while hot furnace light descends and marked bread trays remain visible.

Wide distribution aftermath in a soot-dark geothermal bakehouse. Older broad dark-skinned Enka in a red apron opens a third store lock at the west tray wall; sturdy brown-skinned Ves in a cream headcloth and flour-gray apron reads household marks from the central table; varied bakers in rolled work wraps pass warm flat loaves and small lamp-oil cups to hostel residents and shrine families in an orderly queue; thick-set Taru in a charcoal wrap carries a short list of absent households with his scarred right hand visible. The north ovens glow, the washing trough stays visibly cold, and the east court stair carries distant forge light.

Political aftermath at a central bakehouse scoring table. Compact ochre-brown Nema, black hair knotted above a copper-edged black wrap, stands behind a bronze case full of roster leaves, household marks, passage receipts, and carrier strips. Sturdy brown-skinned Ves in a cream headcloth and flour-gray apron faces her with the day tally flat; older broad dark-skinned Enka in a red apron holds three hostel keys at the west side; thick-set Taru in a charcoal wrap holds a recognizer copy near the east door with his scarred right hand. Varied bakers continue bread work around them under ember light, showing a fully exposed conspiracy embedded in necessary offices and ordinary labor.

Route aftermath viewed from a descending south stair back into a high-fantasy geothermal bakehouse. A young brown-skinned porter in rolled work wraps carries a lidded reed basket down dark stone steps with a scored clay tie visible beneath the cloth. Far inside, sturdy brown-skinned Ves in a cream headcloth and flour-gray apron stands at the central table beside the partial receipt returned from a one-token hearing; compact ochre-brown Nema in a copper-edged black wrap watches from the east court door with a bronze case; hot ovens and marked relief trays divide the background.
